tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Find answers about Jensing: who it helps, which problems it solves, how to get started, cost and funding, who approves the work, what it has built, why it started. Searches by meaning, so ask in plain words, in any language.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one article in full, by the id search_knowledge returned.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List the companies on jensing.com, with industry, stage and a one-line description.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Read about one company, by the slug list_companies returned.

tools.name: how_to_contact
tools.description: Get the email address, the enquiry form and who answers. For when the user wants to talk to Jensing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: how_to_contact · Private data: how_to_contact · Public sink: how_to_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: how_to_contact · Private data: how_to_contact · Public sink: how_to_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
